location: Deir Jarir; Sinjil; Tuba; Humsa al-Bqai'a; Qarawat Bani Hassan
summary: OCHA aggregates five settler assaults/pepper-spray incidents injuring 14 Palestinians, including a child and elderly woman, across five locations/dates.
discovery_sources: OCHA Protection of Civilians 14-27 Mar 2023; WAFA targeted recheck; PLO NAD March 2023 reports
resolution_notes: Targeted recheck further narrowed but did not safely resolve the remaining Sinjil/Tuba components. WAFA reports a Mar. 18 Al-Tuwani/Masafer Yatta settler assault but does not provide an injury count matching OCHA. PLO NAD records a Mar. 16 Tuba assault on Salah Abu Jundiyeh, already separately represented by MAR23-025 / ILPV-2023-0317, but that date falls outside OCHA's 15/18/21/25/26 aggregate dates and must not be forced into the aggregate. NAD also records a Mar. 18 Al-Hamra/Yatta farmer attack without enough injury detail and no clean Mar. 21 event-level match was recovered. Preserve Unresolved rather than allocate OCHA's 14 injuries or dates by guesswork; Deir Jarir, Humsa and Qarawat Bani Hassan remain separately resolved.
media_status: Aggregate only; exact Sinjil/Tuba incident media unresolved; no substitute imagery used.
